verdict.rationale: Stripe clearly supports creating and sending hosted, customizable invoices with online payment collection, no code required (stripe-docs-21, stripe-docs-60, stripe-docs-51). However, the evidence pack does not explicitly document automatic reminder emails for unpaid invoices — the closest analog is 'Smart Retries' and revenue-recovery dunning for subscription payment failures (stripe-docs-14, stripe-docs-31), which is a related but distinct capability from invoice due-date reminders. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic invoice payment reminder emails, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the reminder feature working in practice.
